title: 분실물 보관소
suno_analysis_sp: K-Indie folk ballad featuring fingerstyle acoustic guitar and soft male vocals. The acoustic guitar plays a steady arpeggiated pattern with prominent string noise and fret slides. The vocals are intimate, recorded with a close-mic technique and light plate reverb. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the rhythmic guitar picking and the melodic vocal line. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time, likely in the key of E major. The production is clean and organic, emphasizing the natural timbre of the wooden guitar body.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerstyle acoustic guitar arpeggio]

[Verse 1]
[soft male vocals enter]
새벽 여섯 시 부엌에 선다
형광등 하나 겨우 켜졌다
수도꼭지의 금속이 차갑다
손가락에 냉기가 묻는다
들면 나오는 건 밤새 파이프 안에서 기다린 물인 걸
저 줄기가 손가락 사이로 어제의 마지막 체온처럼
